summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on the integration with Spark, including updates related to Spark versions 4.1 and 4.2. Proposals for new features such as a compact bitmap format and relative path support in the table specification are also being actively discussed.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration updates with Spark 4.1 and 4.2
Proposal for a new bitmap format called Mumbling to optimize space usage
Finalizing the relative paths document to simplify path resolution
Vote in progress for consistent wording on table identifier conflict in REST Spec
